TOKENS_PER_SHARE.details: PRICE_LAST * BNB_USD * 1e18 / OPEN_USDT_PER_TOKEN_E18, rounded      to align last-share per-token price with the pool opening price.      ≈ 9,081.713688562350 TOKEN / share.

AGENT_ID_REGISTRY().notice: SPACE ID Agent ID registry on BSC (HandleRegistry).

BNB_USD().notice: USDT per BNB used to size tokens/share and the pool. Paid wei         prices are independent of this. On deploy day, if the spot rate         differs, recompute:           openWei = OPEN_USDT_PER_TOKEN_E18 * 1e18 / (BNB_USD * 1e18)                   = 3e14 / BNB_USD   (BNB wei per 1 TOKEN)           TOKENS_PER_SHARE = PRICE_LAST * 1e18 / openWei           POOL_TOKENS      = 25.6e18 * TOKENS_PER_SHARE / PRICE_LAST         (or equivalently POOL_TOKENS = 25.6e18 / openWei).

PRICE_LAST().notice: Last paid share (index 14,999) price, wei. 5,281 wei under         10× PRICE_FIRST so the 14,500-share sum is exactly 32 BNB.

lastSharePricePerToken().notice: Last share's BNB-per-token price and the pool opening price (wei BNB / 1 TOKEN).
